
## Install

Windows 10/11 64-bit only for now. Contributions toward macOS and Linux are welcome.

1. Install [Blackmagic Desktop Video](https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/support/family/capture-and-playback) if you haven't already.
2. Download `blender_decklink_output-*-windows-x64.zip` below. Don't unzip it.
3. In Blender 5.0 or newer, open **Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > ⌄ > Install from Disk…** and pick the zip.
4. Open **Properties > Output > Live Camera Output**.

Updating: install the new zip the same way, then restart Blender. Full instructions are in [docs/installation.md](https://github.com/tdoukinitsas/blender-decklink-output/blob/main/docs/installation.md).
